name: Eldrazi titans
description: Ancient titans once imprisoned at the Eye of Ugin.

timeline.summary: After the release of the Eldrazi titans, their broods fill Ondu, but the land itself resists them with crystalline shards, yawning canyons and mesas that grow limbs.
timeline.quote: The defenders of Zendikar found an unpredictable but fierce ally in Ondu’s living terrain.

pages_say.description: Titans whose release led to their broods teeming in Ondu's canyons and forests.
